conclusions: Default attention backend flips 9-10% of items within the same process at conc 8, so batching is not the only cause.
First divergence is early (median token 5, max 42), consistent with prefill/attention numerics rather than late split-K boundaries.
TRITON_ATTN alone eliminates within-process flips, as does VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1; the two together also give 0/100.
Cross-process reproducibility remains ~84% (previous job), so the process environment still matters.

At TP=4, TRITON_ATTN does NOT fix within-process flips (16/100, 15/100, first divergence token 9), so the TP=1 backend fix does not transfer across tensor parallelism; the all-reduce path reintroduces nondeterminism.
Default-backend flip rate is similar at TP=1 (9-10/100) and TP=4 (10-12/100).
BI holds at TP=4 (0/100, 0/100), so batch-invariant mode is the only switch that survives tensor parallelism; TRITON_ATTN alone does not.
